data.title: Iran war could slash global oil demand by over 4% by 2035, IEA says | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Energy markets have been rattled this year by the conflict, which has curbed shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a route that typically carries about a fifth of global oil and natural gas.
data.keywords: Iran,natural gas,oil,iran war scenario,Middle East,Strait of Hormuz,Operation Economic Fury
